description: This file provides utility functions for converting blocking functions into asynchronous ones using the 'anyio' library, and for running async functions in a synchronous context, handling existing event loops.

methods.name: function_has_argument
methods.description: Checks if a given function has a specific argument.

methods.name: asyncify
methods.description: Converts a blocking function into an asynchronous function that runs in a thread.

methods.name: run_async_function
methods.description: Runs an async function in a synchronous context, handling existing event loops.
